newsitem.title: USA: Cortech's Bradycor fails brain injury test.
newsitem.headline: Cortech's Bradycor fails brain injury test.

text.p: Cortech Inc said on Monday the results of a Phase 11 clinical test on its drug Bradycor for traumatic brain injury showed no significant effect and the drug will not be developed.
"We held considerable hope for Bradycor's success and this news clearly comes as a disappointment," President and Chief Executive Officer Kenneth Lynn, said in a statement.

The trial was conducted with SmithKline Beecham and, based on the results, the companies decided to discontinue the planned development of the drug. Conserving cash will be Cortech's near-term objective, Lynn said.
The clinical trial had enrolled 133 patients in 31 centers in North America.
Lynn said Cortech plans to implement an "aggressive restructuring" as it assesses the strategic options available to it.
Cortech has about $21 million in cash, which translates to about $1.12 per share, it said.
